description: A job's disputed fields with each reading (value, quote, page, whether the quote was found word for word) and what the person has answered so far, in page order and row by row, limit at a time (default 25): total says how many there are, next_offset where the next ones start. On a workflow's job, its output's fields by their names, each with the field of ours it came from (source_path); ours: true lists ours. fields keeps only those paths or path prefixes. Show them the readings (get_evidence crops the page) and ask which is right; record their answer with record_answer.

fields.description: Only disputed fields whose path is, or starts with, one of these, e.g. ["vehicles[2]", "named_insured"].

offset.description: How many to skip (default 0): next_offset of the last answer.

ours.description: On a workflow's job: our standard schema's disputed fields instead of its output's.
